text.tspan: Counting by ones is slow and error-prone.
The Rekenrek organizes 20 beads into 5-anchors:
Row 1: 5 Red + 5 White • Row 2: 5 Red + 5 White
Sliding beads in groups turns math into subitizing!

g.text: • Connector Spec: 1.85mm base plug & stacking socket

text.tspan: Snap upright towers into lid for a counting frame.
Slide beads left to add, right to read sums!

g.text: TOTAL: 20 Beads + 4 Frame Parts + Tray + Storage Bin + Lid = 27 Parts
• 5 Red + 5 White per row: Instant 5-anchor visual subitizing.
• Both Rows Active: Models doubles, near-doubles, and bridging.
• Zero-Rattle Carry: Beads slide into nested tray slots.
• High Contrast: Crisp color separation across rows.

text.tspan: Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon
an incomplete set! Every individual math component
is permanently stocked for single replacements.

g.text: Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts

text.tspan: Pack-up is a built-in math game! Slide all
10 red beads to the
left and all 10 white beads to the right on
both rods. Place rods
and towers into the internal nesting tray.
Any missing bead leaves
an immediately visible gap. Lid latches
securely.
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step
hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage
arrangements, and calculator cross-references!
Keep this card stored inside the box lid!

g.text: Designed in Mountain View, California, USA • Non-Toxic BPA-Free.

text.tspan: Dual 5-and-10 grouping bridges perceptual subitizing directly
into formal arithmetic operations.
